mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and employment indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and PAYEMS rise, or interaction effect Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), rising unemployment signals economic distress and reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production indicates weakening manufacturing activity and supply chain disruptions, which reduces corporate profitability and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent price pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and declines in unemployment indicate a tight labor market and aggressive monetary tightening, which reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a rising quarterly GDP growth rate signals sustained economic momentum and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when the regime is late-cycle expansion and GDPC1 growth rate is positive, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
